app.name: VideoStudio
app.tagline: Finished short videos from a voice note

landing.heroTitle: Your voice note, cut like a pro
landing.heroText: Upload a voice note, a talking-head video or a script. VideoStudio writes the storyboard, animates every word, adds captions, sound design and music, and masters the audio. Any language. Any size.
landing.freeNote: 2 free videos a month · 720p with a watermark · no card needed
landing.howTitle: From recording to ready in three steps
landing.step1Text: A voice note, a camera video or a script. Add your photos and clips so they appear exactly where you mention them.
landing.step2Text: The AI writes the storyboard in your language. Check the preview, fix any text, swap an image, insert a shot.
landing.step3Text: Download a mastered MP4 with captions, sound design and music. Rendered in minutes, not hours.
landing.galleryText: Six are open to everyone today. The rest unlock on paid plans as we polish them.
landing.trust1: 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 and custom sizes with platform-safe zones
landing.trust2: Captions, sound effects and music synced to every spoken word
landing.trust3: −14 LUFS mastered audio, true peak under −1 dBTP
landing.featuresTitle: Everything a short-form editor would do
landing.feat1Text: Silences, breaths and retakes are removed; the voice is de-essed, EQ'd and levelled.
landing.feat2Text: Every reveal lands on the word that says it. 24 templates, from numbered tips to product showcases.
landing.feat3Text: Arabic, Hindi, Japanese, Spanish and 20 more scripts with the right fonts and direction.
landing.feat4Text: Upload images and clips; the storyboard puts them in the scenes that talk about them.
landing.feat5Text: Pill, karaoke, pop, line, boxed or none, chunked by pauses with the active word highlighted.
landing.feat6Text: 36 synthesized effects and 13 music moods composed to the length of your video.
landing.pricingTitle: Start free, upgrade when it pays off
landing.pricingText: One credit renders one video up to 90 seconds.
landing.faq1q: What do I need to record?
landing.faq1a: A phone voice memo is enough. Talking-head videos work too; the footage is cut with the same edit as the voice.
landing.faq2a: Transcription covers about 100 languages. On-screen text, captions and fonts adapt automatically, including right-to-left scripts.
landing.faq3q: Can I change what the AI wrote?
landing.faq3a: Yes. Every on-screen text is editable before rendering, and you decide where your images and clips go.
landing.faq4a: You do. Music and sound effects are synthesized and royalty-free; fonts are open-licensed.
landing.finalText: It takes about a minute from upload to preview.
